name: Bioaqua Blackhead Remove Mask Activated Carbon 60gm
description:
Bioaqua Blackhead Removal Mask – Activated Carbon, 60g
Origin: Made in China

Product Highlights:

Deep Pore Cleansing: Gently removes blackheads, cleans pores, and eliminates skin impurities.

Improves Skin Appearance: Helps reduce imperfections and promotes a smoother, healthier-looking face.

Easy to Use:

Apply a warm towel to your face for 2–3 minutes to open pores.

Evenly apply the mask on nose, forehead, chin, and cheeks, avoiding eyes, lips, and eyebrows.

After removing the mask, use a serum to help reduce pore size for best results.

Gentle on Skin: Formulated to cleanse effectively without harsh effects, making it suitable for regular use.
